Subject: Publicity ask for pilot — logo + short quote?

Hi Michael / Laura,

Huge thanks again — the pilot results look great on our side and the execs want to capture a short success story. Two asks from our comms/legal teams:

1) Permission to issue a short press announcement on Dec 15 that references Nebula's use of Redwood for the pilot (no logos, no co-branded assets) — we just need a one-sentence quote from our PM.

Can Redwood accept a staged publicity carveout like that in the MSA/order form? If so, what language do you need and what evidence format will satisfy compliance? Attaching our pilot summary and a quick internal timeline.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Publicity ask for pilot — logo + short quote?

Michael / team — reviewed. Short version: yes, we can accommodate a two-phase publicity approach, but we should do it as an Order Form addendum to keep MSA language stable. High-level suggestions below and attached a marked-up doc (redline_MSA_Nebula_v2.docx) and an evidence checklist (evidence_requirements.xlsx).

Suggested approach (summary):
- Order Form Addendum: "Publicity & Reference Addendum" that grants Redwood a non-exclusive, revocable right to publish a case study and use Nebula's logo subject to the conditions below.
- Phase 1 (Announcement without Logo): customer grants permission for a one-line reference and a short quote; Redwood agrees to share draft language 48 hours before publish for customer sign-off (sign-off not to be unreasonably withheld).
- Phase 2 (Co-branded Case Study + Logo): conditioned on receipt of specified evidence items (run logs, SOC 2 attestation excerpt, and a short compliance checklist). The addendum should require the parties to exchange and confirm evidence at least 10 business days before publication.
- Confidentiality carveout: limited to the project scope and redacts any specific customer PII or proprietary config; add explicit non-disclosure of raw logs beyond what is required for evidence review (we request summary extracts and hash-validated artifacts).
- Approval window: customer gets 48 hours to review drafts; if no response, marketing may proceed after sending one reminder.

Proposed sample clause for Phase 2 (paste-ready):
"Subject to the conditions in this Addendum, Customer hereby grants Redwood Inference a revocable, worldwide license to use Customer's name and logo in a co-branded case study. Customer's approval shall not be unreasonably withheld; Customer shall provide approval or reasonably detailed redlines within forty-eight (48) hours of Redwood's delivery of the draft. For publication of any case study that references security or operational details, Customer shall provide the evidentiary items listed in Schedule A no later than ten (10) business days prior to publication. Redwood shall not publish raw production logs or Personally Identifiable Information in any case study."

Evidence formats (see attached spreadsheet): summary CSVs with SHA256 checksums for each run, SOC 2 section excerpt as PDF, and a signed evidence receipt form. We can accept redacted artifacts — prefer aggregated metrics not raw traces.

I'll sync edits back into a clean Order Form addendum and send a draft by EOD Dec 3.

- Laura

Samantha / Elena — thanks for the ask and for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review please find the agreed plan below and next steps to keep the Dec 15 announcement and Jan 30 case study on track.

1) Legal: we'll add a short "Publicity & Reference Addendum" to the Order Form. Laura will send the clean addendum by EOD Dec 3 (attached).
2) Phase 1 (Dec 15): Redwood may publish a one-line customer reference and a short quote (no logos). Redwood will share the final draft 48 hours prior for your review. Please confirm the preferred quote author (PM or Head of Growth).
3) Phase 2 (Jan 30): co-branded case study + logo — contingent on receipt of evidence (see Laura's Schedule A). Evidence due by Jan 16 (10 business days prior). Acceptable formats: summary CSVs with SHA256 checksums, SOC 2 excerpt PDF, and a completed evidence receipt form.
4) Approval windows: 48 hours for drafts; if no response after one reminder we will assume approval for scheduling purposes (but will not publish PII or raw logs).
5) DocuSign & MAP: Ben will route the Order Form addendum + MAP after Laura's clean copy. DocuSign link to be sent to Elena for signature.

Attached: redline_MSA_Nebula_v2.docx (for reference), evidence_requirements.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf.

- Preferred quote author and a target date to approve Phase 1 draft (we'll send by Dec 13)
